what: A semicircle radar hangs at the bottom of the board: four rings grow from .75x over 1s, entering .15s later one after another from the outside in, and a conic-gradient needle turns once every 10 seconds. At the moment the needle passes a dot (block · allow record), the dot pops from .6→1x, the ring spreads to 3.5x, and .12s later a pill label attaches. It stays until 55% of a turn and goes out at 65%. It pauses when 20% of the board is off-screen

options.--fx-size: Radar diameter (relative to panel width), default 104%
options.--fx-top: Radar top edge (relative to panel height), default 12%

use:
Record name Block
Record name Allowed
note: Dot color uses traffic-light colors via data-tone (ok·warn·bad) — it carries meaning, so it doesn’t follow the skin. The pill’s look (border, background, text) is styled by the consumer.
